# Switch NX2 - read when the Lichii GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
# Beside-application files accept EDEN_NX2_* and the emulator's diagnostic switches only.
# Host environment settings, including library paths such as EDEN_STREAMLINE_DIR, must be
# set in the real environment or the user configuration file at an absolute config location.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Which fence the game waits for when it presents. 1 = the previous frame's: the game prepares the
# next frame while the GPU finishes this one, and waits for this one too while the GPU is behind.
# 0 = this frame's: no overlap. Any value other than 1 means 0, so =2 does not run two frames ahead.
# Unset: per title. Ocarina of Time uses 1, Donkey Kong Bananza 0, and other titles wait for this
# frame unless a GPU channel waits on a semaphore the game releases after the present.
# Ocarina of Time with =0 (or =2): 30.9 fps against 38.9 unset, same spot and settings.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=1

# Guest tensor HMMA.16816.F16 (Ocarina of Time's upscaling network) on the host's tensor cores
# through VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix (#475): registers only, NVIDIA with 32-lane subgroups, checked
# by a startup self-test that falls back to the shader emulation. Off by default; the result is
# within 1 ulp of the emulation, not bit-identical. Its translations are cached separately.
#EDEN_NX2_COOPERATIVE_HMMA=1

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Ocarina of Time real-time speed (the "Real-time speed (built-in)" add-on): below 60 fps the game
# gets the measured frame time as its step, so it no longer runs in slow motion. =0 keeps the
# patch but never writes the delta, i.e. the old fixed 60 Hz step (slow motion below 60 fps).
# EDEN_NX2_OOT_REAL_TIME=0 (Anthony's fork) and EDEN_NX2_REAL_SPEED=0 (Daniel's) are the same
# switch; either one set to 0 turns the write off.
#EDEN_NX2_REAL_SPEED=0
#EDEN_NX2_OOT_REAL_TIME=0
# Deltas below this (default 1.03 = 58.3 fps) are delivered as the fixed 1.0. Range 1.0-1.5. =1.1
# (the earlier default, 54.5 fps) ignores more jitter near 60 fps but runs 54.5-58 fps up to 10 %
# slow, with a speed step where the smoothed frame time crosses 18.3 ms.
#EDEN_NX2_OOT_REAL_TIME_SNAP=1.1

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1
# A draw that reaches a pipeline still queued for a worker-only build claims and builds it on the
# GPU thread instead of waiting behind every pipeline queued on the FIFO workers before it
# (PR 321; single held frames of 1.1-2.2 s in Ocarina). =0 waits for the worker, as after #184.
#EDEN_NX2_HELD_BUILD_INLINE=0
# Compute shaders build the functions they call from several places (a native program's global
# memory functions) as calls instead of inlining them at every call site: NVIDIA spent 2-13 s on
# single Ocarina compute shaders, each a freeze of the whole emulator at its first dispatch.
# =0 builds the SPIR-V as emitted, as before.
#EDEN_NX2_COMPUTE_NOINLINE=0
# The same for graphics modules: functions a vertex, tessellation, geometry, task or mesh shader
# calls from several places are built as calls, not inlined (a 3 s freeze followed a graphics
# pipeline build in Ocarina's Hyrule Field). Fragment shaders keep the driver's inlining by
# default: they run per pixel. =all adds fragment, =0 builds every graphics module as emitted;
# letters pick stages (v vertex, c tess control, e tess eval, g geometry, t task, m mesh,
# f fragment), e.g. =vtm. Case and surrounding spaces are ignored; off/false/none mean =0 and
# on/true mean =1; any other value is logged as a warning and treated as =0.
# Applied when the module is built: the translation cache is unchanged.
#EDEN_NX2_GRAPHICS_NOINLINE=0

# OoT vegetation experiments (PRs 395/421/434). These four fixes default to 1.
# Restart between runs. Use =0 to restore each pre-port behavior; these are candidate switches,
# not intended for nx2. Keep the existing compute/graphics NOINLINE and table-pool settings fixed.
# The on/off switches here (all but AB_TABLE_CAP_MIB) take 1/on/true (or empty) and
# 0/off/false/none, trimmed, any case; any other value
# is logged as a warning and means off. =0 always means off.
# Rebuild native compute translations when a previously null cbuf pointer becomes mapped (max 4).
#EDEN_NX2_COMPUTE_NULL_SLOT_REBUILD=1
# Preserve previously bound direct/table pointers during rebuilds and prefer cached supersets.
# Depends on COMPUTE_NULL_SLOT_REBUILD; =0 retains PR 395's count-only ordering/rebuild behavior.
#EDEN_NX2_COMPUTE_KEEP_POINTERS=1
# Charge second-pass table candidates only for bindings not reserved by the first pass (PR 421).
#EDEN_NX2_POINTER_TABLE_ACCOUNTING=1
# Permit up to 64 storage buffers, capped by device stage/set limits (PR 434); =0 uses legacy 32.
#EDEN_NX2_STORAGE_BUFFERS_64=1

# Maintainer grass-ab 748963271c: all four default OFF (unset or =0). Unlike grass-ab, =0 does
# not enable them. Try one at a time, restarting each run.
# FMin/FMax/FClamp instead of NaN-defined NMin/NMax (reverts #351 behavior).
#EDEN_NX2_AB_FMINMAX=1
# Reject non-triangle mesh output (reverts #432 behavior; may remove draws).
#EDEN_NX2_AB_MESH_TRI_ONLY=1
# Read-only table-pointer pool cap in MiB (reverts #436's broad pools); try 8, then 64.
# Existing TABLE_POOL_FULL=0 still imposes its 64 MiB cap. Values clamp to 1..1024 MiB;
# unset, empty, 0 or a non-number means no cap.
#EDEN_NX2_AB_TABLE_CAP_MIB=8
# Reject QMD releases outside the old strict format (reverts #515 behavior; may stall the game).
#EDEN_NX2_AB_QMD_STRICT=1
# POINTER_TABLE_ACCOUNTING, STORAGE_BUFFERS_64, AB_FMINMAX and AB_MESH_TRI_ONLY change
# translations: their effective values enter the translation-cache config digest, so a run with
# one flipped away from its default gets no offline-product hits. The rest leave it. Preserve a clean
# copy of the field tester's pipeline-key cache and restore it before EACH comparison: rebuilds
# append pointer classifications to that cache, and later runs would otherwise inherit them.
